assets.rightsBasis: Official site-wide header logo served from the college's own domain (escet.in). No open licence; used only to identify the institution. Checked 2026-10-26: HTTP 200, image/png, 41,407 bytes, 631x150 px RGBA, sha256 12809c436bc3d2fc1b4423fa415fd71ef3eed7a86a0e6f356038d7edf2580d4d. Rendered on white and visually confirmed legible: blue interlocking emblem on the left, blue wordmark 'E.S. COLLEGE of Engineering and Technology' and a small address line '3/249, E.S. Nagar, NH-45, Chennai Trunk Road, Villupuram - 605 601, Tamil Nadu, India'. CAVEAT: wide lock-up (4.2:1) at modest resolution; if a square tile is required, crop the left emblem (approx. x 0-160). Rejected: /img/logo/e-larning.png (e-learning portal mark, not the college logo).

HOLD - no single, rights-safe campus photograph of adequate size. The only real exterior view is inside a composite: about_img_03.png (HTTP 200, image/png, 439,941 bytes, 625x598 px, sha256 536f1a4d0d882843f3042467c59b900b3cab74a2db0bf2c5556072eafe8d8baa) stacks two orange-framed rounded panels - a library interior with students at the top and, below, a genuine photograph of the five-storey cream academic block with orange arched corridors, an orange stair tower, palms and a few people at mid distance. A reviewer may approve a transformation crop of the lower panel only (approx. x 18-612, y 285-588, about 594x303 px, inside the orange border), but it is low resolution and keeps rounded-corner artefacts; not recommended without review. Other candidates rejected 2026-10-26: gallery e-s-college-of-engineering-and-technology-01 to -09.jpg (800x534, 2012 job-fair and visitor event photos dominated by identifiable people; -04 shows the entrance arch partly behind a crowd); /img/blog/inner_b1-3.jpg, /img/deportment/*.jpg, /img/bg/cta_bg.png and blog_bg.png are stock or illustrative images, not the campus; the home-page hero is a YouTube video, not an image.
